metadata.description: Find the cheapest way to get a whole shopping list delivered. Claude prices the list on Wolt, Glovo and Bolt Food, whichever of them deliver where you are, with delivery, service and small-order fees included, and names the store, or the split between two stores, that costs least. No account needed.
